midlander.th: มิดแลนเดอร์

highlander.th: ไฮแลนเดอร์

features.f: A plain human woman: round human ears, no tail, horns, scales or markings, ordinary human proportions. Midlanders are average height and slender with a soft, youthful face; Highlanders are taller and sturdier with broader shoulders, stronger cheekbones and a squarer jaw.
features.m: A plain human man: round human ears, no tail, horns, scales or markings, ordinary human proportions. Midlanders are average height with a lean, balanced build and softer features; Highlanders are clearly taller and broad-shouldered with a muscular frame, a heavy brow and a square jaw.

f.desc: An off-the-shoulder white blouse with short puffed, slit sleeves and a white choker, cinched by a dark brown laced leather corset and a tan buckled belt, over a short crimson skirt with white overskirt panels trimmed in dark brown leather and silver diamond studs, and dark garter straps. Brown leather fingerless gauntlets with flared cuffs and dark brown laced thigh-high boots with low heels.

m.desc: An open white short-sleeved tunic with a tan leather collar and shoulder yoke, worn over a black pleated shirt and a black laced leather waistcoat whose front hangs like a short kilt with silver crest badges, cinched by a white studded belt with a pouch, with a thin brown strap across the chest and a small pendant necklace. A long black leather bracer on one forearm, black fingerless gloves, white knee-length breeches and tall black thigh boots with grey turned-down cuffs.

notes: Hairs: taken from the creator's Hairstyle menu (Lobby 234) in CharaMakeType rows 0-3 (0 Midlander m, 1 Midlander f, 2 Highlander m, 3 Highlander f; Gender 0 = male). Every menu entry is a CharaMakeCustomize row with IsPurchasable=false and no unlock item; the Modern Aesthetics and event styles are separate rows that are not in the menu, so the whole menu is free at creation. The two clans do NOT share one list: the menus hold Midlander m 53, Midlander f 54, Highlander m 52, Highlander f 48. FeatureIDs 1-15 and 51-54 are clan models (the same number is a different style in each clan), and 103 is Highlander-only; FeatureIDs 102 and up are the same style in both clans (checked icon by icon). Merged by look: Midlander base styles in Midlander creator order, then Highlander-only styles in Highlander creator order, then the shared styles in creator order. 'clan' marks a style only one clan can pick; no 'clan' means both. 'feature' gives the FeatureID per clan so the icon can be traced (icon id = CharaMakeCustomize.Icon). Same style under different numbers: male Mid 5 = High 4, Mid 6 = High 2, Mid 8 = High 12, Mid 11 = High 7, Mid 13 = High 103; female Mid 7 = High 11, Mid 12 = High 4, Mid 13 = High 7, Mid 14 = High 103. 'variantOf' marks the 51-54 extras, which are near copies of a base style. Female 51/52/53 are the hairband style in white/purple/pink (the base is black); the male ones change only which front locks are tucked back or how many face braids show, which is barely visible at chibi size. m18 (feature 54) differs from m17 only by a few wisps behind the ear. Accessory colours were read off 192px icons: the brown headband cord (m05), silver clip (m39), silver bead (f20) and silver cuffs (f32) are tiny and may be slightly off. The ribbon in f38/f39 and the hairband in f34 look the same colour as the hair, so they are left in hair colour. Attire: the creator outfit is CharaMakeType Equipment[0], model e0084 variant 2 (male) and e0085 variant 2 (female), the same for both clans; an Item search on ModelMain returns the Hyuran items listed. Described from the item icons and the Armoury Collection preview renders. Height: consolegameswiki ranges. 'scale' uses the Midlander default (the more common clan) over 90 cm; byClan gives Highlander too (the Lalafell default is really about 92 cm, which would make every scale about 2% smaller). Skins: the interface half of human.cmp as extracted by xivdyetools (192 colours per clan and gender, 8 columns from light to dark); one pick per column, drawn from both clans. In that data the Highlander female palette is identical to the Midlander female one; the male palettes differ (Highlander slightly ruddier and darker).
